proposal.prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories with the same mean but different age-weighted sums, such as [1,0,0,0] versus [0,0,0,1]. Their predicted responses differ through H1 and H2; equality within calibrated error would refute the retained recency-sensitive history representation.

quantities.interpretation: Oldest prior drive, four seconds before the current time.
quantities.name: H1

quantities.interpretation: Most recent prior drive, one second before the current time.
quantities.name: H2

proposal.refutation_condition: Reject this representation if prospective matched conditions show RMSE above 0.06 or if same-mean early-versus-late histories have indistinguishable responses within the 0.015 response-unit calibration bound.
proposal.scientific_change: Replace the instantaneous-only response assumption with explicit dependence on the oldest and most recent prior drives. The observed matched-input contrasts show strong history effects and distinguish history ordering; the intermediate history entries are not yet established as necessary.

proposal.prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories with equal mean but different temporal order, including [1,0,0,0] versus [0,0,0,1]. If their responses differ beyond measurement uncertainty, a mean-only history summary is inadequate.

quantities.interpretation: Mean of the four prior drives, ignoring their order.
quantities.name: history_mean

proposal.refutation_condition: Reject the mean-only history representation if rows with identical u, h, and history_mean have response differences exceeding the 0.03-unit maximum pairwise difference allowed by the stated 0.015-unit readout error bound.
proposal.scientific_change: Test whether prior drives can be represented by their mean, changing the retained assumption that history order may matter into an explicit representation check before fitting a response formula.

unit_audit.convention: Unconstrained unit choices assigned zero; not unique physical identification

tool_feedback.explanation: Exact symbolic equality of the supplied feature values forces any deterministic downstream function to give identical predictions. Unknown equalities are not merged. Passing this check does not prove the features sufficient or any model valid.

proposal.prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories that differ only in the oldest or newest drive. The existing matched contrasts show order-sensitive history effects; additional prospective contrasts can test whether either endpoint's effect changes with h.

quantities.interpretation: Oldest prior drive, over the interval ending at -4 s.
quantities.name: oldest_drive

quantities.interpretation: Most recent prior drive, over the interval ending at -1 s.
quantities.name: newest_drive

proposal.refutation_condition: Refute this representation if the completed sparse polynomial fails raw-response RMSE <= 0.06 on the supplied dev data, or if independent matched-condition responses show systematic residuals beyond the calibrated 0.015-unit readout bound.
proposal.scientific_change: Replace the instantaneous-only response assumption with an order-sensitive history representation using the oldest and newest prior drives. Matched histories with equal means but different order have distinct responses, while the available evidence does not establish that the two intermediate drives are needed.

proposal.prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories with the same mean but different order, such as [1,0,0,0] versus [0,0,0,1]. The representation predicts a response difference through history_trend; indistinguishable responses within the calibrated 0.015-unit readout bound would refute retaining this order-sensitive summary.

quantities.interpretation: Average of the four prior drives, preserving their overall level.
quantities.name: history_mean

quantities.interpretation: Difference between newest and oldest prior drive, measuring a linear recency trend.
quantities.name: history_trend

proposal.refutation_condition: Reject this model if its fit-only parameter estimation and dev-selected sparse polynomial cannot achieve raw-response RMSE <= 0.06 on the supplied dev rows, or if later independent matched-condition predictions exceed that criterion.
proposal.scientific_change: Revise the instantaneous-input assumption to let response depend on both the average prior drive and its temporal direction. The distinct responses for equal-mean reordered histories reject a mean-only summary; intermediate entries and nonlinear time kernels remain unresolved.
